supersedes.de1: AUTOLOOP-PI-GRAPH-DE1 selection held as PROVISIONAL: EXISTING AUTOLOOP LEADS (external review HOLD / DE1_RESEARCH_EXTENSION_REQUIRED, 2026-08-08)

rationale: DE-1R ran Candidate B (Temporal) as a LIVE server deployment with the same real-SIGKILL failure classes (S0-S6). The provisional selection is now finalized by measurement, not assumption.
Temporal recovers automatically (re-dispatch + deterministic replay, zero lost results) — a genuine improvement over STACK_A's manual resume and F1/F2/F3 gaps.

But Temporal's at-least-once activity semantics re-execute the ENTIRE writer activity from scratch after a mid-activity kill and duplicate the committed side effect unless the app implements an idempotency pattern (S3 vs S4). STACK_A already fails the writer CLOSED (0 duplicates in all 22 DE-1 runs). The writer-dedup burden is NOT removed by Temporal — it is relocated to app code that DE-2 would add to STACK_A anyway.

Temporal does not provide an automatic exactly-once workflowId guard after completion (S5: default reuse allows a new execution; REJECT_DUPLICATE only blocks while running), whereas STACK_A's repeated resume returns COMPLETE with zero re-execution (T11).

Corrupt-state handling: STACK_A rejects a tampered checkpoint at resume time; Temporal/SQLite detects corruption but validates lazily on access (S6). Both fail closed; STACK_A's detection is proactive.
Footprint: 1 server process (196MB) + DB + 3 listeners + worker + SDK (154 packages) + workflow versioning vs zero added services for STACK_A.
F1/F2/F3 (the only real recoverability gaps found in DE-1) are bounded, in-process, fail-closed fixes squarely in DE-2 scope — not architectural gaps requiring a workflow runtime.
AutoLoop's graph model does not require durable timers/signals/long-running workflows (DE-1 fitNotes).
Restate is eliminated by the Stage 13 gate (SEC-1 @scarf/scarf phone-home BLOCKER + SEC-2 BSL), re-verified live (see de1r-restate-disposition.json).

selectionStatus: FINALIZED — DE-1 provisional selection (EXISTING AUTOLOOP LEADS) upgraded to a measured final: PASS / EXISTING_DURABLE_EXECUTION_SELECTED
nextStep: DE-2 — Native Durable Execution Hardening: (1) wire STACK_A behind runColimaGraph (production Graph path durability), (2) complete the resume post-head whitelist (F1), (3) fix the resumed-orchestrator journal/revision edge (F2/F3), (4) telemetry replay-awareness (D7), (5) writer worktree restoration policy. Optionally adopt Temporal's idempotency commit-token pattern as a reference for DE-2 writer dedup.
recommendation: Do NOT introduce Temporal or Restate as production dependencies. The existing durable layer (STACK_A) remains the correct base; its F1/F2/F3 gaps are bounded DE-2 hardening work.
